cells.value: Check proper condition and connection of cables and connectors of all units
Check for hanging and loose cables.
Check Cabinets and units undamaged and clean
Check that steel parts, other than stainless steel, are painted or otherwise treated to prevent corrosion.
Check that aluminum Alloy parts are painted or otherwise treated to prevent corrosion.
Check that paint and coating are in good condition.
Check that warning placards and markings are complete.
Check that units are correctly positioned, supported and fastened.
Check that no cooling leakage signs in the Antenna room, HVPS Rack upper cover, in the pipes between the rack to the main cooling system.
Check for LED indication on the front panel of TRGs, Filters, EPU 1 and EPU 2.
Check operation of all alarm controls of Heat exchanger.
Check all Air Filters are cleaned as per Maintenance Manual para 2.5.2
Check battery of UPS charged in 6 Months as per Maintenance manual para 2.5.3.
Check Last report of pH value of Coolant. Between 6 and 8. Fill the Value
Check that after 2 years of use, ethylene coolant has been replaced or approval for extension has been taken or not.
Check state of HE pumps Basket strainer filter.
Check functioning of booster pumps and HE pumps.
All the TRG's are in place
TRG removed (if any) is disabled from software and cables are secured and covered properly
